Recognizing History 🌰

In recognition of Black History Month, throughout the month we will be honoring various individuals from the past and present whose contributions shaped our history at Ohio State and inspire further change in our world today. 

First up, Ohio’s very own, Jesse Owens. The Cleveland native and his impact still transcends the realm of sports today. From setting 4 world records in one day, to winning 4 gold medals at the 1936 Olympic Games, Owens worked tirelessly to promote the ascension of the modern Olympic Games.
